name: logbook_qa_en
description: English retrieval evaluation over the 8-entry fixture logbook corpus (log-001..log-008). Covers single-source lookups, multi-source questions, deliberate lexical-matching weaknesses, and out-of-corpus questions the service should decline.

cases.query: Was the Line 2 conveyor belt checked during the morning shift?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes - the morning shift equipment check found no anomalies; safety guards in place and lubrication nominal.

cases.query: What happened near the loading dock?
cases.expected_answer_note: A minor slip at 14:32; no injuries; area cordoned off with wet floor signage.

cases.query: What was the boiler pressure recorded at handover?
cases.expected_answer_note: Boiler 3 was stable at 145 psi at the night-to-day handover.

cases.query: Were the fire extinguishers in warehouse zone B inspected?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes - inspected and tagged current during the zone B safety walk; exit routes clear.

cases.query: Which machine had its drive belt replaced?
cases.expected_answer_note: Packaging machine 4; tested and back in service at 09:15.

cases.query: What caused the fire alarm during the night shift?
cases.expected_answer_note: Dust buildup near the server room at 02:47; confirmed a false alarm.

cases.query: Who visited the site for the HVAC inspection?
cases.expected_answer_note: A contractor team, escorted by facilities staff, 10:00 to 11:30.

cases.query: Describe the forklift near-miss in aisle 7
cases.expected_answer_note: A forklift narrowly avoided a pedestrian; mirrors and refresher training recommended.

cases.query: Which entries describe safety incidents involving people?
cases.expected_answer_note: The loading dock slip and the aisle 7 forklift near-miss. BM25 has no stemming, so 'incidents' does not match 'Incident report'. This case is expected to score poorly today and exists to make that weakness visible.

cases.query: What maintenance work was carried out and what is outstanding?
cases.expected_answer_note: Drive belt replaced on packaging machine 4; no outstanding maintenance requests at handover.

cases.query: Did a worker fall over by the delivery bay?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes - a minor slip near the loading dock, no injuries. Shares almost no content words with the source entry ('fall' vs 'slip', 'delivery bay' vs 'loading dock'), so keyword retrieval struggles. This is the gap a dense retriever exists to close.

cases.query: Why did the building emergency siren activate before dawn?
cases.expected_answer_note: Dust near the server room set off the alarm at 02:47. The word 'emergency' pulls the zone B safety walk up the ranking - a genuine keyword-retrieval failure mode.

cases.query: What did the night shift report?
cases.expected_answer_note: The 02:47 false fire alarm, and the handover note recording Boiler 3 stable at 145 psi with no outstanding maintenance.

cases.query: What is the company parental leave policy?
cases.expected_answer_note: Nothing in the logbook covers HR policy, so the service should decline. It does not today: the dense stub always supplies a chunk, so there is always evidence to cite. See the refusal gap in tests/eval/README.md.

cases.query: How do I reset my payroll password?
cases.expected_answer_note: No corpus term matches at all, so BM25 returns nothing. The service should decline; today it answers anyway from the dense stub's chunk.
